'''A sergeant''' served in the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]]. [[Gender/Legends|He]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the [[Battle of Kalaan]]. Following his death, [[Brenn Tantor]] took de facto command of his forces.
